payload.title: File:AGB5841 (referred to Iteravis huchzermeyeri).jpg
payload.artist_html: X. Wang, J. Huang, Y. Hu, X. Liu, J. Peteya & J. A. Clarke
payload.credit_html: "The earliest evidence for a supraorbital salt gland in dinosaurs in new Early Cretaceous ornithurines"
payload.description_html: Photograph of the AGB5841, referred to Iteravis huchzermeyeri (=Gansus zheni). Anatomical abbreviations: cc, crop content; co, coracoid; cv, cervical vertebra; fe, femur; fu, furcula; g, gastralia; ga, gastrolith; h, hyoid; hu, humerus; il, ilium; mcI–III, metacarpals I–III; pd I–IV, pedal digits I–IV; phI-1, the first phalanx of digit I; phI-2, the second phalanx of digit I; phII-1,the first phalanx of digit II; phII-2,the second phalanx of digit II; pu, pubis; py, pygostyle; ra, radius; rad, radiale; ri, rib; sc, scapula; sgf, salt gland fossa; sk, skull;; ti, tibiotarsus; tm, tarsometatarsus; tv, thoracic vertebra; ul, ulna; uln, ulnare. Insets show melanosomes of sampled feathers of AGB5841. (a) Sampled from breast feather; (b) sampled from primary feather.
